shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin surpassed $75K to hit a 3-month high, driven by strong ETF inflows and short liquidations.
President Trump urged Congress to pass the CLARITY Act to establish a clear regulatory framework for digital assets.
Expanded US Treasury long-term bond buybacks are seen as monetary easing, lowering yields and supporting risk assets like crypto.
Eurozone inflation increased to 2.9% in July 2026, with officials hinting at potential future interest rate hikes if inflation persists.
